title: Single misbehaving strategy reverts entire claim() (liveness loss across all strategies)
justification: Protocol availability impact per C4 Medium definition: a single failing strategy.withdrawFrom DoSes claims across all strategies until owner remediates. No try/catch isolation. Stated assumption: at least one strategy can fail or be made to revert (third-party strategy bug, paused underlying, etc.). Not High since funds are not stolen; classic liveness loss.
impact: All claimers blocked across all strategies until owner removes/pauses the offending strategy. Yield continues to accrue but is unclaimable.
attack_path_summary: 1) Any registered strategy.withdrawFrom reverts (pause, malicious, bug). 2) Every claim() reverts because the strategy iteration aborts. 3) Liveness lost until owner intervenes.
